title: Commission creation, approval, locking and principal view

cases.title: Utilities Connected with 3 products at rate 60 creates one Pending commission of 180
Moving an Opportunity to Utilities Connected shows a Pending commission
Reopen and re-win, or two racing updates, never leave two live commissions
Changing the agency rate leaves existing commissions unchanged
Reopening cancels a Pending commission with reason "Opportunity reopened"
Reopening after approval keeps the commission, sets Reopened After Approval and notifies Finance (retried if the send fails)
Finance receives the reopened-after-approval bell notification
Nobody, not even an admin without bypass, can edit Amount, Rate, Opportunity or Agency
Editing a commission's Amount is refused with a clear message
A Partner Manager approves a Pending commission and Approved By / On are stamped
A sales rep cannot approve a commission
A Partner Manager cannot change an Approved commission; Finance can
Partner Manager is refused when moving an Approved commission back to Pending
Commission is shared read-only with the agency's Executive role only; agents and other agencies have no access
A principal sees this month's and last month's commission totals
An agent does not see the commission tiles
Tile totals count non-cancelled commissions by created month
200 Opportunities to Utilities Connected create and share 200 commissions
A Partner Manager (Standard User + PR_Partner_Manager) who does not own the commission can approve a Pending commission owned by a sales rep (System.runAs)
